registered_before: the corrected model was scored on the 2025-2026 holdout
why: The pre-registered model was implemented literally and the implementation was found to be defective. The defect was found and diagnosed on the 1999-2022 development window only. The correction below was selected on the development window only. The registered thresholds, the validation gates and the holdout definition are unchanged.

defect.what: data/gates_preregistered.json registers the mean reversion as a share of a team's rating reverted toward the league mean after each game, with rho = 0.03. Because the ratings are re-identified to a zero mean after every game, the league mean is zero and a per-game share acts only as a multiplicative decay of the entire rating scale. A 3% decay applied after every game removes essentially the whole rating within a season: the end-of-season rating standard deviation was about 1.3 points, against the roughly 6 to 9 points that real team strength differences produce.

development_window_evidence.note: The same rating update with the reversion applied once between seasons instead of after every game produces a lower error on the development window, which is the only window used to make this decision.

primary_variant.name: Corrected model: reversion applied between seasons

development_window_selection.objective: lowest mean absolute error of the game margin
development_window_selection.grid: alpha in {0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08, 0.10} crossed with home field advantage in {0.0, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0}, with rho = 0.03 applied between seasons
development_window_selection.runner_up: alpha 0.06, home field advantage 2.5 points, development mean absolute error 10.7277

variants_retained_from_the_original_regi: V1 to V6 are retained and reported. V1 to V6 use the defective per-game reversion and are therefore reported as diagnostics, not as candidates for reward. The reward board is decided among V7 and V8 only.

reward_board_scope.rule: The forecast reward board is decided among the corrected variants V7 and V8. The defective variants are shown for transparency and are not eligible for reward points.
